scope: Independent 42-task evaluation, five additional episodes per task
selection: Deterministic stratified sampling over all public seed groups; exclude recorded episode IDs and previously selected reset indices for each task variant; prefer unused file digests and balance groups. Generalization uses two standard and three random layouts.

seed_semantics.policy_rng_seed: WALL serving initial seed 0 with episode-local keyframe and RNG history

pairing: Reuse this manifest unchanged across methods; compare observed initial fingerprints too
invalid_layout_policy: Record and exclude native-invalid cases; no automatic replacement or retry

local_instruction_clarification.purpose: Wait for the demonstrating arm to return before either controlled arm moves
